workouts.title: Metcon
workouts.description:
EMOM 28
1: 16 Wall Balls @ 20/14lbs; 10/9ft
2: 4 Power Clean @102.5 / 70 kg
3: Max Cal Row
4: Rest
NOTES:
- Be sure the wall balls are unbroken each round. If not, then scale back the weight.
- If you can't complete the power cleans under :45, then scale back the weight to something you can complete under :45 in quick singles.
- On the row, the goal is consistency across ALL seven rounds of this EMOM. Start at a pace that is
moderate for round one, but that will be tough to sustain by round seven. If you don't know what this pace will be, start conservatively and try to maintain your effort or have slightly negative splits.
